sections.text:
Building Compliant Futures Since 2019

IntegPro is Australia’s leading ISO certification and DISP compliance consulting firm. For over 25 years, we’ve helped businesses across Defence, Construction, Medical Devices, Government, and Manufacturing achieve and maintain world-class management systems.

Meet Our Team
Our Values
25+ Years of Excellence

From a small Sydney consultancy to Australia’s leading ISO & DISP certification partner

3-6 months

Timeline:

ISO 14001 Environmental Management

What you get:

• Environmental aspects register
• Legal compliance matrix
• Environmental policy and objectives
• Operational controls
• EMS documentation

Outcome

- ISO 14001 Certificate 

- Enhance Sustainability  

- Legal Compliance relevant to Environmental Protection 

- Protect Environment and minimise impacts 

Get Quote

3-6 months

Timeline:

ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety

What you get:

• Hazard identification & risk assessment
• OH&S policy & objectives
• Legal & compliance register
• Worker consultation framework
• OHSMS documentation

Outcome

- ISO 45001 Certificate
- Legal Compliance relevant to Workplace Health and Safety
- Positive and safe culture

- Confidence to manage complex and high-risk operations

Get Quote

2019

Foundation

IntegPro established in Sydney to help Australian businesses navigate ISO certification.

2021

National Expansion

Grew to service clients nationwide across all major industries and sectors.

2023

Industry Leader

EQMS, 100% first-audit success rate, and Australia’s most trusted ISO & DISP consultancy.

2020

Auditing

Expanded into Defence Industry Security Program consulting, becoming a trusted DISP advisor.

2022

1000th Certification

Celebrated milestone achievement of delivering 1000+ successful certifications (ISDM /DISP/Maintenance)

​Today, IntegPro Stands as Australia’s Most Trusted ISO & DISP Consultancy

We’ve maintained our founding commitment to practical, results-driven consulting while expanding our expertise across all major industries and compliance frameworks.

Our Core Values

The principles that guide every client engagement and certification journey

Integrity First

We provide honest, transparent advice without overselling. Your compliance journey is built on trust and ethical consulting practices.

Practical Expertise

No cookie-cutter solutions. We tailor every system to your industry, size, and operational reality, compliance that works for you.

Results-Driven

100% first-audit success rate speaks for itself. We focus on practical outcomes, not just paperwork, delivering certifications that stick.

Continuous Improvement

Certification is the start, not the end. We help you leverage ISO and DISP for genuine business improvement and competitive advantage.

Partnership Approach

​We work alongside your team, building internal capability while delivering compliance. Your success is our success.

Client-Centric

​Your challenges, timelines, and budget matter. We adapt our service delivery to minimize disruption and maximize value.

Our Mission

To empower Australian businesses with world-class management systems that deliver genuine competitive advantage, operational excellence, and sustainable compliance.

​“We don’t just deliver certifications, we build compliant, high-performing organizations.”

Meet the IntegPro Team

Certified professionals with deep industry expertise and a passion for compliance excellence

Mehrdad Permeh

Managing Director & Lead Consultant

Lead and train teams in quality and Lean practices, manage integrated systems for ISO compliance, and drive continuous improvement through audits and risk-based strategies.

Maria Fernanda Bolivar

ISO Consultant

Quality assurance expert with a science and business background, experienced across pharma, medical devices, and regulatory roles in Australia and Colombia.

​

Parham Karimi

DISP Consultant

Engineering graduate focused on quality systems, aiming to build a career in Quality Engineering through expertise in process control, safety, and compliance.

​

Why Choose IntegPro?

The IntegPro difference: expertise, transparency, and results

100%

Certified Excellence

Our team holds the highest industry certifications and accreditations
